findings.note: Sabres.com (Oct 20) says Jason Zucker returns to boost Buffalo's last-ranked power play, and Colten Ellis likely starts in goal; he was pulled in his last start after allowing two goals in 26 minutes.

Team stats cut both ways: Philly scores just 1.40 goals per game (good for the Under), but Buffalo allows 3.67 per game, its goalies are saving about .860-.864, and its penalty kill is at 64.5%; Couturier, Tippett and Foerster are day-to-day and Dahlin may return.

ESPN's Oct 21 preview lists BUF -192 with an O/U of 5.5 (CBS also shows 5.5), so the offered Under 6 is a half goal above the posted total; it notes the Flyers have won two straight after an 0-9 start.
